:::{#def-epe}
#### Expected squared prediction error at a covariate value

The **expected squared prediction error at $x$**
of a [fitting procedure](#def-fitting-procedure) $g$
at training-set size $n$
is the mean squared [prediction error](estimation.qmd#def-prediction-error)
of its prediction at $x$ for a new outcome $Y_0$ with $X_0 = x$,
averaged over random [training sets](#def-training-set) $\trainset$ of $n$ observations
drawn independently of $(X_0, Y_0)$,
and over $Y_0$:

$$
\epe{x} \eqdef \E{\sqf{g\paren{x; \trainset} - Y_0} \mid X_0 = x}.
$$ {#eq-epe}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

@hastie2009elements [sec. 7.3], who write this quantity as $\generr(x_0)$.
:::

:::
